description: Source code implementing time conversion functions between POSIX time and struct tm, including validation and range checks, inspired by Howard Hinnant's date algorithms.

methods.name: is_valid_date
methods.description: Checks if a given year/month/day combination is valid within the range 0000-9999.

methods.name: is_valid_time
methods.description: Validates if the provided hours, minutes, and seconds constitute a valid time (excluding leap seconds).

methods.name: is_valid_epoch_time
methods.description: Checks if a given int64_t time is within the supported range (from year 0000 to 9999).

methods.name: posix_time_from_utc
methods.description: Converts a date/time in UTC to POSIX time_t, based on Howard Hinnant's algorithm.

methods.name: utc_from_posix_time
methods.description: Converts POSIX time_t to UTC date/time components, using Howard Hinnant's algorithm.

methods.name: OPENSSL_tm_to_posix
methods.description: Converts a struct tm to POSIX time (int64_t).

methods.name: OPENSSL_posix_to_tm
methods.description: Converts POSIX time (int64_t) to a struct tm.

methods.name: OPENSSL_timegm
methods.description: Converts a struct tm to time_t in UTC, with range checks.

methods.name: OPENSSL_gmtime
methods.description: Converts time_t to UTC struct tm.

methods.name: OPENSSL_gmtime_adj
methods.description: Adjusts a struct tm by a specified number of days and seconds.

methods.name: OPENSSL_gmtime_diff
methods.description: Calculates the difference in days and seconds between two struct tm instances.
